event_records.description: The Sunmark housing cooperative board has called a special general meeting for September 12 to vote on amending the pet policy. Notices have been sent to all members.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_board.name: Sunmark housing cooperative board
sunmark_housing_cooperative_board.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative board.
The board has called a special general meeting for September 12 to vote on amending the pet policy. They are aware of the two-thirds member turnout requirement in the bylaws. They have sent notices to all members about the meeting and the proposed amendment.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_members.name: Sunmark housing cooperative members
sunmark_housing_cooperative_members.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative members.
Each member has received notice of the special general meeting on September 12 regarding the pet policy amendment. Members have varying levels of interest in the pet policy and may or may not plan to attend. Some members may be unable to attend due to other commitments.

resolution.question: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all Sunmark housing cooperative members actually attended (or were represented by proxy, if allowed) the special general meeting on September 12, 2026, before the meeting's conclusion. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
